name: Fluorouracil
route_note: IV bolus or continuous infusion (often with leucovorin); topical cream for actinic keratoses and superficial basal cell carcinoma
originator: Charles Heidelberger (University of Wisconsin) with Hoffmann-La Roche

discovery.by: Charles Heidelberger, with Robert Duschinsky of Hoffmann-La Roche
discovery.note: Rationally designed after observing that tumour cells take up uracil avidly; fluorine at the 5-position blocks thymidylate synthesis.

tagline: Rationally designed pyrimidine analogue, backbone of colorectal and GI cancer regimens
summary: Fluorouracil (5-FU) is a pyrimidine analogue that is converted inside cells into nucleotides that inhibit thymidylate synthase and are misincorporated into RNA and DNA. It is the backbone of FOLFOX, FOLFIRI and FOLFIRINOX regimens for gastrointestinal cancers and is also used for breast and head and neck cancer and topically for skin lesions.
mechanism: 5-FU is converted to fluorodeoxyuridine monophosphate (FdUMP), which forms a stable ternary complex with thymidylate synthase and 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate, blocking thymidine synthesis and causing 'thymineless death'. Leucovorin increases the folate cofactor and stabilises this complex.
Its triphosphate metabolites FUTP and FdUTP are incorporated into RNA and DNA, disrupting RNA processing and DNA integrity.
More than 80% of a dose is catabolised by dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD, gene DPYD); patients with DPD deficiency can develop severe or fatal toxicity.
uses: Pancreatic, gastric, oesophageal and anal cancer
Topical: actinic keratoses and superficial basal cell carcinoma

history.title: Design and synthesis
history.detail: Heidelberger and Duschinsky report 5-fluorouracil and its antitumour activity in Nature.

history.title: FDA approval
history.detail: Approved for palliative treatment of gastrointestinal cancers.

history.title: Topical approval
history.detail: Topical fluorouracil (Efudex) approved for actinic keratoses.

history.title: Adjuvant colon cancer
history.detail: NIH consensus recommends adjuvant 5-FU plus levamisole for stage III colon cancer after Moertel's trial.

history.title: FOLFOX/FOLFIRI era
history.detail: Infusional 5-FU with leucovorin plus oxaliplatin or irinotecan becomes standard for metastatic colorectal cancer.

history.title: DPD testing
history.detail: EMA recommends testing for DPD deficiency before starting fluorouracil, capecitabine and related drugs.

pk.bioavailability: oral absorption erratic (not used orally); IV
pk.metabolism: hepatic and extrahepatic DPD catabolism; intracellular anabolism to active nucleotides

facts: Uridine triacetate is an antidote for fluorouracil or capecitabine overdose or early-onset severe toxicity.
